section.p: Consider creating a new alarm notification procedure where an icon appears as part of the instruction itself.

table.title: Inline image inside a numbered list (procedure)

entry.codeblock: # Creating a New Alarm Notification 1. Click the ![Add Icon](images/add-icon.png) icon. 2. Enter the notification details. 3. Click **Save**.

<task id="creating_a_new_alarm_notification"> <title>Creating a New Alarm Notification</title> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd> Click the <image href="media/add-icon.png"> <alt>Add Icon</alt> </image> icon. </cmd> </step> <step> <cmd>Enter the notification details.</cmd> </step> <step> <cmd>Click <uicontrol>Save</uicontrol>.</cmd> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result: The converter preserves the image as inline content within the step command. The image remains part of the instruction rather than becoming a separate figure or supporting image.
